provisions.title: Duties on receiving a correction request

negative

value.reason: The Evidence shows two things. At login.component.ts:106 the user's email (Contact data) is saved to localStorage. At request.interceptor.ts:23 it is read back and sent as the 'X-User-Email' header. That matches the source-to-header pattern in the positive example. But the examples show that this pattern alone does not decide the Finding. The negative example stores the email in localStorage and adds the same header, and it only differs because the header is limited to requests where req.url.startsWith(API_BASE). The excerpt here is just the single header line inside setHeaders, so we can't see the clone call or any condition before it. We can't tell whether the header goes out on every outgoing request (including third-party hosts) or only to the app's own API. Without the surrounding interceptor code, the Evidence isn't enough to call this a true or false positive.
